# UX Polish Rules

Small, strict rule-sets (spacing, type, motion, loaders, empty states) that separate premium from generic.

[← All categories](README.md)

<a id="anti-slop"></a>
### Anti-Slop

`vectorlab-ux-skills:anti-slop` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Removes AI-template clichés: rainbow gradients, glassmorphism, cartoon empty states, decorative pills and input icons.

**Use when**
- Reviewing any AI-generated UI
- Before every client demo

**How to use**
- Delete decoration, never structure (keep table frames, dividers, search)

**Pairs with:** [Frontend Design](uiux.md#frontend-design) · [Colour Palette & Elevation](polish.md#colour-palette)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#anti-slop](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#anti-slop)

<a id="empty-states"></a>
### Empty States

`vectorlab-ux-skills:empty-states` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Every empty view states what belongs there, why it matters, and gives one primary action; filtered-empty offers 'Clear filters'.

**Use when**
- Building any list, board, table or first-run screen

**How to use**
- Keep the page skeleton visible in the empty state

**Pairs with:** [Loaders](polish.md#loaders) · [Verbs (button labels)](polish.md#verbs)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#states](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#states)

<a id="loaders"></a>
### Loaders

`vectorlab-ux-skills:loaders` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Loader by duration: none < 100ms, inline 100ms-1s, structural skeleton > 1s.

**Use when**
- Adding spinners, skeletons or async fetches

**How to use**
- Never a full-page spinner; skeletons mirror the real layout

**Pairs with:** [Empty States](polish.md#empty-states)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#states](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#states)

<a id="page-patterns"></a>
### Page Patterns

`vectorlab-ux-skills:page-patterns` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Forces one named page pattern (list, detail, form, dashboard, settings, board, calendar, split pane, analytics, inbox) before any page markup.

**Use when**
- Before creating any new screen or route

**Avoid when**
- Components inside a page (charts, tiles)

**How to use**
- Overview = Dashboard (glance, max 5 KPIs, read-only)
- Pipeline = Board
- Clients = List
- One client = Detail

**Pairs with:** [Surfaces (inline / slide-over / page)](polish.md#surfaces) · [Viewports](polish.md#viewports)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#page-patterns](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#page-patterns)

---

<a id="surfaces"></a>
### Surfaces (inline / slide-over / page)

`vectorlab-ux-skills:surfaces` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Routes each task to the lightest surface: inline edit, slide-over or a dedicated page; named confirmations for destructive actions.

**Use when**
- Adding any modal, drawer, dialog or inline edit

**How to use**
- <10s task: slide-over; >=10s or multi-step: its own page; single field: inline, zero layout shift
- Destructive confirm names the item: "Delete client 'Harbor & Pine'?"

**Pairs with:** [Page Patterns](polish.md#page-patterns) · [Keyboard](polish.md#keyboard)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#surfaces](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#surfaces)

---

<a id="viewports"></a>
### Viewports

`vectorlab-ux-skills:viewports` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Works from 375px to 1280px: no page overflow, collapsing chrome, 44px targets, no hover-only actions.

**Use when**
- Every page, before calling it done

**How to use**
- Test at 375 and 1280; tables/boards scroll inside their region only

**Pairs with:** [Page Patterns](polish.md#page-patterns)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#responsive](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#responsive)

<a id="colour-palette"></a>
### Colour Palette & Elevation

`vectorlab-ux-skills:colour-palette` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

60-30-10 color distribution; depth via 1px subtle borders then soft shadows (alpha < 0.08).

**Use when**
- Choosing surfaces, borders, shadows, accents or dark-mode depth

**How to use**
- Accent only on actions, active nav, links and focus; never on big fills

**Pairs with:** [Anti-Slop](polish.md#anti-slop) · [Typography](polish.md#typography)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#color](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#color)

<a id="errors"></a>
### Errors

`vectorlab-ux-skills:errors` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Error copy never blames the user and always offers recovery.

**Use when**
- Writing errors, toasts or failure states

**How to use**
- Say what happened, why (if known), and what to do next

<a id="forms"></a>
### Forms

`vectorlab-ux-skills:forms` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Validate on blur, clear errors instantly, fewer fields, always-clickable submit.

**Use when**
- Building add-client, add-deal, settings or any form

**How to use**
- Ask only for what v1 needs; everything else is optional later

### Keyboard

`vectorlab-ux-skills:keyboard` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

<a id="motion"></a>
### Motion

`vectorlab-ux-skills:motion` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Duration tokens 100/150/200/300ms, ease-out in / ease-in out, animate transform & opacity only, no bouncy chrome.

**Use when**
- Adding any transition or animation

**How to use**
- One motion language per product
- No infinite decorative loops

**Pairs with:** [Transitions](polish.md#transitions) · [Reduced Motion](polish.md#reduced-motion)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#motion](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#motion)

<a id="spacing"></a>
### Spacing & Alignment

`vectorlab-ux-skills:spacing` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

8pt grid for components, 4pt for micro spacing, 65-75ch line length, cap-height icon alignment.

**Use when**
- Laying out any screen

**How to use**
- Tokens: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64

**Pairs with:** [Typography](polish.md#typography) · [Viewports](polish.md#viewports)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#spacing](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#spacing)

<a id="transitions"></a>
### Transitions

`vectorlab-ux-skills:transitions` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Enter/exit patterns for overlays and lists with zero layout jump.

**Use when**
- Animating drawers, dialogs, popovers, route changes, staggered lists

**How to use**
- Slide-overs: translateX + opacity 200ms in, 150ms out

**Pairs with:** [Motion](polish.md#motion)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#motion](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#motion)

<a id="typography"></a>
### Typography

`vectorlab-ux-skills:typography` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Max 3 weights (never > 700), 16/14/12px base sizes, line-height inversely related to size.

**Use when**
- Setting type styles or fixing noisy hierarchy

**How to use**
- Table cells use 14-16px, never 12px
- Hierarchy from size and spacing, not weight

**Pairs with:** [Spacing & Alignment](polish.md#spacing)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#typography](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#typography)
